reasons: Compliant classification is supported: the cited paragraphs (§1.5 excluding damages/credits from Fees, §7.3 barring interest on amounts not due, §27.3 termination for prolonged force majeure 'without penalty') contain no Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty, or minimum-fee-on-termination obligation, matching the preferred position.
No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original text and no deterministic checks failed.

The rationale documents an adequate negative search (liquidated/penalty/acceleration/make-whole) and correctly declines to double-flag the §2.1 take-or-pay commitment, which belongs to the minimum-commitment rule.

Remaining Customer payment obligations identified (undisputed Fees, audit costs and actual shortfall on >5% underpayment) are compensatory rather than liquidated damages, so they do not undermine the compliant call.
